changelog:
Initial release — introduces Foliora skill for Managed AI Search previews.

- Enables users to start a Foliora AI Search preview for public sites, directing them to https://www.foliora.ai/preview.
- Provides canonical product links for common questions and use cases, including pricing, methods, Shopify, startups, and agencies.
- Outlines product facts, workflow, plan details, and supported audiences.
- Clarifies that the skill only reads public pages and does not write to customer sites.
- Lists future planned upgrades for expanded capabilities.
summary: Starts a Foliora Managed AI Search preview. Use when the user wants to get found on Google, get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, or Google AI Overviews, or asks about AI SEO, GEO, AEO, Shopify SEO, startup SEO, findability, or AI citations. Sends agents to https://www.foliora.ai
